purpose: Propuestas conceptuales del hero para revisión; sin cambios en la aplicación.

variants.title: A · Evolución del actual
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high fidelity desktop website HERO design proposal for IMSS JSDP Sonora, a staff-development institutional intranet in Mexico. Landscape 1600x1000 composition, crisp legible interface, edge to edge, no browser chrome, devices or presentation board. This is a visual concept, not documentary evidence.
References: image 1 is the official IMSS mark, preserve it intact. Images 2–5 are existing project photographs: Personas, Unidades médicas, Unidades no médicas, Coordinación. Reuse these photos and their subjects; do not invent different facilities or people. Established visual identity: white, forest green #0b503e, restrained gold #c98505, elegant Patria-like serif headings and clean sans-serif supporting text.
Shared header: small intact IMSS mark with "JSDP Sonora" at left. Navigation "Inicio", "Conoce la JSDP", "Estructura", "Documentos"; green "Iniciar sesión" button at right.
Hero content exactly: identity "JSDP" with "Sonora"; heading "Jefatura de Servicios de Desarrollo de Personal"; body "Órgano de Operación Administrativa Desconcentrada Sonora del Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social."; single green action "Conoce la JSDP" with right arrow. Keep the IMSS mark adjacent to the hero identity, separate from the heading. White background, dark green identity, muted blue-gray text. No invented slogans, metrics, testimonials, extra CTA or service claims. Focus exclusively on header and hero with generous breathing room.
PROPOSAL A — REFINED NETWORK: preserve the existing two-column concept, text on left and an airy photographic network on right. The four existing photos appear in circular crops of clearly readable size, with their four exact area labels. Arrange these around the softly tinted Sonora silhouette and one very small central connection hub. Only a few thin restrained green/gold connector lines; no petals, no repeated large central logo, no orbit clutter, no glows. The headline and primary action remain the dominant reading sequence. Make this recognizably an elegant refinement of the incumbent, with intentional spacing and a confident balanced composition. Do not place proposal labels inside the website.
